extracted.intended_audience: Researchers at UK research organisations seeking NERC / UKRI funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and eligibility/administrative constraints for applying to specific NERC / UKRI funding opportunities (e.g., Global Partnerships Seedcorn Fund 2026 and a UKRI metascience scientometrics call). Includes who can apply, mandatory partners, award limits, and application windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant organisational eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for NERC funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is stated as an eligibility requirement for the Environmental sciences: Global Partnerships Seedcorn Fund 2026; applicants should confirm their host organisation is on NERC's list of eligible UK research organisations before applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory international project partners
rubrics_metrics.description: The inclusion of one or more international project partners is mandatory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For the Global Partnerships Seedcorn Fund 2026, applications must include at least one international partner — proposals without international partners will not meet this eligibility requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project fit — create new sustainable global partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for funding to create new and sustainable global partnerships in environmental science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should be aligned to the explicit aim of establishing new and sustainable international partnerships in environmental science; relevance to this objective will affect suitability for the Seedcorn Fund.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadlines (Seedcorn Fund)
rubrics_metrics.description: Opening date: 5 May 2026 9:00am UK time. Closing date: 16 July 2026 4:00pm UK time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted within this window; late applications will not be accepted. Note the timezone (UK time) for submission timestamps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only requirement (UKRI metascience scientometrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The UKRI metascience scientometrics call is invite-only; unsolicited applications will not be accepted. Confirm you have an invitation before preparing an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project fit — metascience scientometrics scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for funding to develop, validate, and critique novel scientometric indicators for use in research assessment and in metascience research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should clearly address the development/validation/critique of novel scientometric indicators and their application to research assessment or metascience; alignment with this scope is a primary consideration for this opportunity.
